description: Ministry of Public Services Provincial Councils ad Local Government - Amendment to the Minutes on Pensions
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Schedule "Q" of the Minutes on Pensions to include new positions (Coordinating Secretary to the Speaker and Chief Government Whip) and specifies their effective date. The content deals specifically with public service pension regulations and benefits, which falls under the Public Service category (Type 8) for public sector service conditions and benefits.
